what does players.banningenabled do | players banningenabled property | what is the banningenabled property of a players | what is banningenabled in roblox => Players.BanningEnabled is a true/false property. Enables or disables the three Players methods (BanAsync(), UnbanAsync(), and GetBanHistoryAsync()) that constitute the ban API. This property cannot be set through developer-facing Luau and must be set in Studio through the Players properties window.

what is a meshpart in roblox | what does meshpart do in roblox | roblox meshpart class => MeshPart is a Roblox class. A form of BasePart that includes a physically simulated custom mesh.
what does meshpart.doublesided do | meshpart doublesided property | what is the doublesided property of a meshpart | what is doublesided in roblox => MeshPart.DoubleSided is a true/false property. Determines whether to render both faces of polygons in the mesh.
what does meshpart.meshcontent do | meshpart meshcontent property | what is the meshcontent property of a meshpart | what is meshcontent in roblox => MeshPart.MeshContent is a Content property. The mesh that is displayed on the MeshPart. Supports asset URIs and EditableMesh objects.
what does meshpart.meshid do | meshpart meshid property | what is the meshid property of a meshpart | what is meshid in roblox => MeshPart.MeshId is a ContentId property. The asset URIs of the mesh that is displayed on the MeshPart. Reads and writes to MeshContent.
what does meshpart.renderfidelity do | meshpart renderfidelity property | what is the renderfidelity property of a meshpart | what is renderfidelity in roblox => MeshPart.RenderFidelity is an Enum.RenderFidelity property. The level of detail used to render the MeshPart.
what does meshpart.texturecontent do | meshpart texturecontent property | what is the texturecontent property of a meshpart => MeshPart.TextureContent is a Content property. The texture applied to the MeshPart. Supports asset URIs and EditableImage objects.
what does meshpart.textureid do | meshpart textureid property | what is the textureid property of a meshpart => MeshPart.TextureID is a ContentId property. The texture applied to the MeshPart. Reads and writes to TextureContent.
what does meshpart:applymesh do | how do i use applymesh in roblox | meshpart applymesh function => Overwrites the MeshContent, TextureContent, and collision geometry properties of this MeshPart from the given source meshPart. Use it like `meshPart:ApplyMesh(meshPart)`.
what is a model in roblox | what does model do in roblox | roblox model class => Model is a Roblox class. Models are container objects, meaning they group objects together. They are best used to hold collections of BaseParts and have a number of functions that extend their functionality.
what does model.primarypart do | model primarypart property | what is the primarypart property of a model | what is primarypart in roblox => Model.PrimaryPart is a BasePart property. The primary part of the Model, or nil if not explicitly set.
what does model.worldpivot do | model worldpivot property | what is the worldpivot property of a model | what is worldpivot in roblox => Model.WorldPivot is a CFrame property. Determines where the pivot of a Model which does not have a set Model.PrimaryPart is located.
what does model:addpersistentplayer do | how do i use addpersistentplayer in roblox | model addpersistentplayer function => Sets this model to be persistent for the specified player. ModelStreamingMode must be set to PersistentPerPlayer for behavior to be changed as a result of addition. Use it like `model:AddPersistentPlayer(playerInstance)`.
what does model:getboundingbox do | how do i use getboundingbox in roblox | model getboundingbox function => Returns a description of a volume that contains all parts of a Model. Use it like `model:GetBoundingBox()`. It returns one or more values.
what does model:getextentssize do | how do i use getextentssize in roblox | model getextentssize function => Returns the size of the smallest bounding box that contains all of the BaseParts in the Model, aligned with the Model.PrimaryPart if it is set. Use it like `model:GetExtentsSize()`. It returns a Vector3.
what does model:getpersistentplayers do | how do i use getpersistentplayers in roblox | model getpersistentplayers function => Returns all the Player objects that this model object is persistent for. Behavior varies based on whether this method is called from a Script or a LocalScript. Use it like `model:GetPersistentPlayers()`. It returns an array (a list table).
what does model:getscale do | how do i use getscale in roblox | model getscale function => Returns the canonical scale of the model, which defaults to 1 for newly created models and will change as it is scaled via Model:ScaleTo(). Use it like `model:GetScale()`. It returns a number.
what does model:moveto do | how do i use moveto in roblox | model moveto function => Moves the PrimaryPart to the given position. If a primary part has not been specified, the root part of the model will be used. Use it like `model:MoveTo(position)`.
what does model:removepersistentplayer do | how do i use removepersistentplayer in roblox | model removepersistentplayer function => Makes this model no longer persistent for the specified player. ModelStreamingMode must be set to PersistentPerPlayer for behavior to be changed as a result of removal. Use it like `model:RemovePersistentPlayer(playerInstance)`.
what does model:scaleto do | how do i use scaleto in roblox | model scaleto function => Sets the scale factor of the model, adjusting the sizing and location of all descendant Instances such that they have that scale factor relative to their initial sizes and locations when scale factor was 1. Use it like `model:ScaleTo(newScaleFactor)`.
what does model:translateby do | how do i use translateby in roblox | model translateby function => Shifts a Model by the given Vector3 offset, preserving the model's orientation. If another BasePart or Terrain already exists at the new position then the Model will overlap said object. Use it like `model:TranslateBy(delta)`.
what is a pvinstance in roblox | what does pvinstance do in roblox | roblox pvinstance class => PVInstance is a Roblox class. Abstract class for all objects that have a physical location in the world.
what does pvinstance:getpivot do | how do i use getpivot in roblox | pvinstance getpivot function => Gets the pivot of a PVInstance. Use it like `pVInstance:GetPivot()`. It returns a CFrame.
what does pvinstance:pivotto do | how do i use pivotto in roblox | pvinstance pivotto function => Transforms the PVInstance along with all of its descendant PVInstances such that the pivot is now located at the specified CFrame. Use it like `pVInstance:PivotTo(targetCFrame)`.
what is a humanoid in roblox | what does humanoid do in roblox | roblox humanoid class => Humanoid is a Roblox class. A special object that gives models the functionality of a character.
what does humanoid.autojumpenabled do | humanoid autojumpenabled property | what is the autojumpenabled property of a humanoid => Humanoid.AutoJumpEnabled is a true/false property. Sets whether the character will automatically jump when they hit an obstacle as a player on a mobile device.
what does humanoid.automaticscalingenabled do | humanoid automaticscalingenabled property | what is the automaticscalingenabled property of a humanoid | what is automaticscalingenabled in roblox => Humanoid.AutomaticScalingEnabled is a true/false property. When Enabled, AutomaticScalingEnabled causes the size of the character to change in response to the values in the humanoid's child scale values changing.
what does humanoid.autorotate do | humanoid autorotate property | what is the autorotate property of a humanoid | what is autorotate in roblox => Humanoid.AutoRotate is a true/false property. AutoRotate sets whether or not the Humanoid will automatically rotate to face in the direction they are moving in.
what does humanoid.breakjointsondeath do | humanoid breakjointsondeath property | what is the breakjointsondeath property of a humanoid | what is breakjointsondeath in roblox => Humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath is a true/false property. Determines whether the humanoid's joints break when in the Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead state.
what does humanoid.cameraoffset do | humanoid cameraoffset property | what is the cameraoffset property of a humanoid | what is cameraoffset in roblox => Humanoid.CameraOffset is a Vector3 property. An offset applied to the Camera's subject position when its CameraSubject is set to this Humanoid.
what does humanoid.displaydistancetype do | humanoid displaydistancetype property | what is the displaydistancetype property of a humanoid | what is displaydistancetype in roblox => Humanoid.DisplayDistanceType is an Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType property. Controls the distance behavior of the humanoid's name and health display.
what does humanoid.displayname do | humanoid displayname property | what is the displayname property of a humanoid => Humanoid.DisplayName is a string (text) property. Sets the text of a Humanoid, displayed above their head.
what does humanoid.evaluatestatemachine do | humanoid evaluatestatemachine property | what is the evaluatestatemachine property of a humanoid | what is evaluatestatemachine in roblox => Humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine is a true/false property. Used to disable the internal physics and state machine of the Humanoid.
what does humanoid.floormaterial do | humanoid floormaterial property | what is the floormaterial property of a humanoid | what is floormaterial in roblox => Humanoid.FloorMaterial is an Enum.Material property. If the Humanoid isn't standing on anything, the value of this property will be Air. It is read-only.
what does humanoid.healthdisplaydistance do | humanoid healthdisplaydistance property | what is the healthdisplaydistance property of a humanoid => Humanoid.HealthDisplayDistance is a number property. Used in conjunction with the DisplayDistanceType property to control the distance from which a humanoid's health bar can be seen.
what does humanoid.healthdisplaytype do | humanoid healthdisplaytype property | what is the healthdisplaytype property of a humanoid | what is healthdisplaytype in roblox => Humanoid.HealthDisplayType is an Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType property. Controls when the humanoid's health bar is allowed to be displayed.
what does humanoid.hipheight do | humanoid hipheight property | what is the hipheight property of a humanoid | what is hipheight in roblox => Humanoid.HipHeight is a number property. Determines the distance off the ground the Humanoid.RootPart should be.
what does humanoid.jump do | humanoid jump property | what is the jump property of a humanoid => Humanoid.Jump is a true/false property. If true, the Humanoid jumps with an upwards force.
what does humanoid.jumpheight do | humanoid jumpheight property | what is the jumpheight property of a humanoid | what is jumpheight in roblox => Humanoid.JumpHeight is a number property. Provides control over the height that the Humanoid jumps to.
what does humanoid.jumppower do | humanoid jumppower property | what is the jumppower property of a humanoid | what is jumppower in roblox => Humanoid.JumpPower is a number property. Determines how much upwards force is applied to the Humanoid when jumping.
what does humanoid.maxhealth do | humanoid maxhealth property | what is the maxhealth property of a humanoid | what is maxhealth in roblox => Humanoid.MaxHealth is a number property. The maximum value of a humanoid's Health.
what does humanoid.maxslopeangle do | humanoid maxslopeangle property | what is the maxslopeangle property of a humanoid | what is maxslopeangle in roblox => Humanoid.MaxSlopeAngle is a number property. The maximum slope angle that a humanoid can walk on without slipping.
what does humanoid.movedirection do | humanoid movedirection property | what is the movedirection property of a humanoid | what is movedirection in roblox => Humanoid.MoveDirection is a Vector3 property. Describes the direction that the Humanoid is walking in. It is read-only.
what does humanoid.namedisplaydistance do | humanoid namedisplaydistance property | what is the namedisplaydistance property of a humanoid => Humanoid.NameDisplayDistance is a number property. Used in conjunction with the Humanoid.DisplayDistanceType property to control the distance from which a humanoid's name can be seen.
what does humanoid.nameocclusion do | humanoid nameocclusion property | what is the nameocclusion property of a humanoid | what is nameocclusion in roblox => Humanoid.NameOcclusion is an Enum.NameOcclusion property. Controls whether a humanoid's name and health bar can be seen behind walls or other objects.
what does humanoid.requiresneck do | humanoid requiresneck property | what is the requiresneck property of a humanoid | what is requiresneck in roblox => Humanoid.RequiresNeck is a true/false property. Allows developers to disable the behavior where a player character dies if the Neck Motor6D is removed or disconnected even momentarily.
what does humanoid.rigtype do | humanoid rigtype property | what is the rigtype property of a humanoid | what is rigtype in roblox => Humanoid.RigType is an Enum.HumanoidRigType property. Describes whether this Humanoid is utilizing the legacy R6 character rig, or the new R15 character rig.
what does humanoid.rootpart do | humanoid rootpart property | what is the rootpart property of a humanoid | what is rootpart in roblox => Humanoid.RootPart is a BasePart property. A reference to the humanoid's HumanoidRootPart object. It is read-only.
what does humanoid.targetpoint do | humanoid targetpoint property | what is the targetpoint property of a humanoid | what is targetpoint in roblox => Humanoid.TargetPoint is a Vector3 property. Describes the 3D position where the Player controlling the Humanoid last clicked in the world while using a Tool.
what does humanoid.usejumppower do | humanoid usejumppower property | what is the usejumppower property of a humanoid | what is usejumppower in roblox => Humanoid.UseJumpPower is a true/false property. Determines whether the JumpHeight (false) or Humanoid.JumpPower (true) property is used.
what does humanoid.walkspeed do | humanoid walkspeed property | what is the walkspeed property of a humanoid | what is walkspeed in roblox => Humanoid.WalkSpeed is a number property. Describes the humanoid's maximum movement speed in studs per second.
what does humanoid.walktopart do | humanoid walktopart property | what is the walktopart property of a humanoid | what is walktopart in roblox => Humanoid.WalkToPart is a BasePart property. A reference to a part whose position is trying to be reached by a humanoid.
what does humanoid.walktopoint do | humanoid walktopoint property | what is the walktopoint property of a humanoid | what is walktopoint in roblox => Humanoid.WalkToPoint is a Vector3 property. The position that a humanoid is trying to reach, after a call to Humanoid:MoveTo() is made.
what does humanoid:addaccessory do | how do i use addaccessory in roblox | humanoid addaccessory function => Attaches the specified Accessory to the humanoid's parent. Use it like `humanoid:AddAccessory(accessory)`.
what does humanoid:applydescriptionasync do | how do i use applydescriptionasync in roblox | humanoid applydescriptionasync function => Makes the character's look match that of the passed in HumanoidDescription. If HumanoidDescription.UseAvatarSettings is true, the Avatar Settings for the experience will also be applied to the character. Use it like `humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync(humanoidDescription, assetTypeVerification)`. It yields, so the script waits until it finishes.
what does humanoid:applydescriptionresetasync do | how do i use applydescriptionresetasync in roblox | humanoid applydescriptionresetasync function => Makes the character's look match that of the passed in HumanoidDescription, even after external changes. Use it like `humanoid:ApplyDescriptionResetAsync(humanoidDescription, assetTypeVerification)`. It yields, so the script waits until it finishes.
what does humanoid:buildrigfromattachments do | how do i use buildrigfromattachments in roblox | humanoid buildrigfromattachments function => Assembles a tree of Motor6D joints by attaching together Attachment objects in a humanoid's character. Use it like `humanoid:BuildRigFromAttachments()`.
what does humanoid:changestate do | how do i use changestate in roblox | humanoid changestate function => Sets the Humanoid to enter the given Enum.HumanoidStateType. Use it like `humanoid:ChangeState(state)`.

what does humanoid:getapplieddescription do | how do i use getapplieddescription in roblox | humanoid getapplieddescription function => Returns a copy of the humanoid's cached HumanoidDescription which describes its current look. Use it like `humanoid:GetAppliedDescription()`. It returns a HumanoidDescription.
what does humanoid:getbodypartr15 do | how do i use getbodypartr15 in roblox | humanoid getbodypartr15 function => Pass a body part to this method (the body part should be a sibling of Humanoid, and a child of a Model) to get the Enum.BodyPartR15 of the Part. Use it like `humanoid:GetBodyPartR15(part)`. It returns an Enum.BodyPartR15 value.
what does humanoid:getlimb do | how do i use getlimb in roblox | humanoid getlimb function => Returns the Enum.Limb enum that is associated with the given Part. Use it like `humanoid:GetLimb(part)`. It returns an Enum.Limb value.
what does humanoid:getrelativevelocityatfloor do | how do i use getrelativevelocityatfloor in roblox | humanoid getrelativevelocityatfloor function => Returns the humanoid's actual physical velocity relative to the surface it is standing on as a Vector3 in world-space orientation. Use it like `humanoid:GetRelativeVelocityAtFloor()`. It returns a Vector3.
what does humanoid:getstate do | how do i use getstate in roblox | humanoid getstate function => Returns the humanoid's current Enum.HumanoidStateType. Use it like `humanoid:GetState()`. It returns an Enum.HumanoidStateType value.
what does humanoid:getstateenabled do | how do i use getstateenabled in roblox | humanoid getstateenabled function => Returns whether a Enum.HumanoidStateType is enabled for the Humanoid. Use it like `humanoid:GetStateEnabled(state)`. It returns true or false.
what does humanoid:move do | humanoid move function => Causes the Humanoid to walk in the given direction. Use it like `humanoid:Move(moveDirection, relativeToCamera)`.
what does humanoid:moveto do | humanoid moveto function => Causes the Humanoid to attempt to walk to the given location by setting the Humanoid.WalkToPoint and Humanoid.WalkToPart properties. Use it like `humanoid:MoveTo(location, part)`.
what does humanoid:playemoteasync do | how do i use playemoteasync in roblox | humanoid playemoteasync function => Plays emotes and returns if was successfully ran. Use it like `humanoid:PlayEmoteAsync(emoteName)`. It returns true or false. It yields, so the script waits until it finishes.

what is the humanoid.applydescriptionfinished event | when does humanoid applydescriptionfinished fire | humanoid applydescriptionfinished event roblox => Fires when a HumanoidDescription has finished being applied to the Humanoid. Connect it with `humanoid.ApplyDescriptionFinished:Connect(function(description) end)`.
what is the humanoid.climbing event | when does humanoid climbing fire | humanoid climbing event roblox => Fires when the speed at which a Humanoid is climbing changes. Connect it with `humanoid.Climbing:Connect(function(speed) end)`.
what is the humanoid.died event | when does humanoid died fire | humanoid died event roblox => Fires when the Humanoid dies. Connect it with `humanoid.Died:Connect(function() end)`.
what is the humanoid.fallingdown event | when does humanoid fallingdown fire | humanoid fallingdown event roblox => Fires when the Humanoid enters or leaves the FallingDown Enum.HumanoidStateType. Connect it with `humanoid.FallingDown:Connect(function(active) end)`.
what is the humanoid.freefalling event | when does humanoid freefalling fire | humanoid freefalling event roblox => Fires when the Humanoid enters or leaves the Freefall Enum.HumanoidStateType. Connect it with `humanoid.FreeFalling:Connect(function(active) end)`.
what is the humanoid.gettingup event | when does humanoid gettingup fire | humanoid gettingup event roblox => Fires when the Humanoid enters or leaves the GettingUp Enum.HumanoidStateType. Connect it with `humanoid.GettingUp:Connect(function(active) end)`.
what is the humanoid.healthchanged event | when does humanoid healthchanged fire | humanoid healthchanged event roblox => Fires when the Humanoid.Health changes (or when the Humanoid.MaxHealth is set). Connect it with `humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health) end)`.
what is the humanoid.jumping event | when does humanoid jumping fire | humanoid jumping event roblox => Fires when the Humanoid enters and leaves the Jumping Enum.HumanoidStateType. Connect it with `humanoid.Jumping:Connect(function(active) end)`.
what is the humanoid.movetofinished event | when does humanoid movetofinished fire | humanoid movetofinished event roblox => Fires when the Humanoid finishes walking to a goal declared by Humanoid:MoveTo(). Connect it with `humanoid.MoveToFinished:Connect(function(reached) end)`.
what is the humanoid.platformstanding event | when does humanoid platformstanding fire | humanoid platformstanding event roblox => Fires when the Humanoid enters or leaves the PlatformStanding Enum.HumanoidStateType. Connect it with `humanoid.PlatformStanding:Connect(function(active) end)`.
what is the humanoid.ragdoll event | when does humanoid ragdoll fire | humanoid ragdoll event roblox => Fires when the Humanoid enters or leaves the Ragdoll Enum.HumanoidStateType. Connect it with `humanoid.Ragdoll:Connect(function(active) end)`.
what is the humanoid.running event | when does humanoid running fire | humanoid running event roblox => Fires when the speed at which a Humanoid is running changes. Connect it with `humanoid.Running:Connect(function(speed) end)`.
what is the humanoid.seated event | when does humanoid seated fire | humanoid seated event roblox => Fired when a Humanoid either sits in a Seat or VehicleSeat or gets up. Connect it with `humanoid.Seated:Connect(function(active, currentSeatPart) end)`.

what is the humanoid.touched event | when does humanoid touched fire | humanoid touched event roblox => Fires when one of the humanoid's limbs come in contact with another BasePart. Connect it with `humanoid.Touched:Connect(function(touchingPart, humanoidPart) end)`.
what is a replicatedstorage in roblox | what does replicatedstorage do in roblox | roblox replicatedstorage class => ReplicatedStorage is a Roblox class. A container service for objects that are replicated to all clients.
what is a serverstorage in roblox | what does serverstorage do in roblox | roblox serverstorage class => ServerStorage is a Roblox class. A container whose contents are only accessible on the server. Objects descending from ServerStorage will not replicate to the client and will not be accessible from LocalScripts.

what is a tweenservice in roblox | what does tweenservice do in roblox | roblox tweenservice class => TweenService is a Roblox class. Used to create Tweens which interpolate, or tween, the properties of instances.

Use it like `game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(instance, tweenInfo, propertyTable)`. It returns a Tween.

what does tweenservice:smoothdamp do | how do i use smoothdamp in roblox | tweenservice smoothdamp function => Smoothly interpolates a value towards a target, simulating a critically damped spring. Use it like `game:GetService("TweenService"):SmoothDamp(current, target, velocity, smoothTime, maxSpeed, dt)`. It returns one or more values.
what is a tweenbase in roblox | what does tweenbase do in roblox | roblox tweenbase class => TweenBase is a Roblox class. Abstract base class for in-between interpolation handlers. Tween inherits from TweenBase.
what does tweenbase:cancel do | how do i use cancel in roblox | tweenbase cancel function => Halts playback and resets the tween variables. If you then call TweenBase:Play(), the properties of the tween resume interpolating towards their destination, but take the full length of the animation to do so. Use it like `tweenBase:Cancel()`.
what does tweenbase:pause do | how do i use pause in roblox | tweenbase pause function => Halts playback of the tween. Doesn't reset its progress variables, meaning that if you call TweenBase:Play(), the tween resumes playback from the moment it was paused. Use it like `tweenBase:Pause()`.
what does tweenbase:play do | how do i use play in roblox | tweenbase play function => Starts playback of a tween. Note that if playback has already started, calling Play() has no effect unless the tween has finished or is stopped (either by TweenBase:Cancel() or TweenBase:Pause()). Use it like `tweenBase:Play()`.
what is the tweenbase.completed event | when does tweenbase completed fire | tweenbase completed event roblox => Fires when the tween finishes playing or when stopped with TweenBase:Cancel(). Connect it with `tweenBase.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState) end)`.
what is a tween in roblox | what does tween do in roblox | roblox tween class => Tween is a Roblox class. The Tween object controls the playback of an interpolation.
what does tween.instance do | tween instance property | what is the instance property of a tween => Tween.Instance is an Instance property. Read-only property that points to the Instance whose properties are being interpolated by the tween. It is read-only.
what does tween.tweeninfo do | tween tweeninfo property | what is the tweeninfo property of a tween | what is tweeninfo in roblox => Tween.TweenInfo is a TweenInfo property. Read-only property that includes information on how the interpolation of the Tween is to be carried out. It is read-only.
what is a runservice in roblox | what does runservice do in roblox | roblox runservice class => RunService is a Roblox class. Service responsible for all runtime activity and progression of time.
what does runservice:bindtoanimation do | how do i use bindtoanimation in roblox | runservice bindtoanimation function => Binds a custom function to be called at a fixed frequency before Animators update when fixed simulation is enabled, or immediately before BindToSimulation callbacks otherwise. Use it like `game:GetService("RunService"):BindToAnimation(function, frequency, priority)`. It returns an RBXScriptConnection.

what is the runservice.misprediction event | when does runservice misprediction fire | runservice misprediction event roblox => In the server authority model, fires during prediction when the engine detects that the client has diverged from the server's authoritative state. Intended for plugin-based debugging. Connect it with `game:GetService("RunService").Misprediction:Connect(function(time, instances, stats) end)`.

what is the runservice.presimulation event | when does runservice presimulation fire | runservice presimulation event roblox => Fires every frame, prior to the physics simulation. Connect it with `game:GetService("RunService").PreSimulation:Connect(function(deltaTimeSim) end)`.

what is the runservice.rollback event | when does runservice rollback fire | runservice rollback event roblox => In the server authority model, this fires after rolling back the predicted state due to a misprediction, but before resimulation begins. Connect it with `game:GetService("RunService").Rollback:Connect(function(time) end)`.
what is the runservice.stepped event | when does runservice stepped fire | runservice stepped event roblox => Fires every frame, prior to the physics simulation. Connect it with `game:GetService("RunService").Stepped:Connect(function(time, deltaTime) end)`.

what is a soundservice in roblox | what does soundservice do in roblox | roblox soundservice class => SoundService is a Roblox class. A service that determines various aspects of how the audio engine works. Most of its properties affect how Sounds play in the experience.

Determines whether the default character sounds will use instances in the advanced audio system vs. Sounds.
what does soundservice.defaultlistenerlocation do | soundservice defaultlistenerlocation property | what is the defaultlistenerlocation property of a soundservice | what is defaultlistenerlocation in roblox => SoundService.DefaultListenerLocation is an Enum.ListenerLocation property. Determines where (if anywhere) to place an AudioListener by default.
what does soundservice.distancefactor do | soundservice distancefactor property | what is the distancefactor property of a soundservice | what is distancefactor in roblox => SoundService.DistanceFactor is a number property. The number of studs to be considered a meter by SoundService when simulating the Doppler effect for Sounds.
what does soundservice.dopplerscale do | soundservice dopplerscale property | what is the dopplerscale property of a soundservice | what is dopplerscale in roblox => SoundService.DopplerScale is a number property. Degree to which the pitch of a Sound varies due to the Doppler effect.
what does soundservice.listenercframe do | soundservice listenercframe property | what is the listenercframe property of a soundservice | what is listenercframe in roblox => SoundService.ListenerCFrame is a CFrame property. The CFrame that is used as the listener's position if ListenerType is set to Enum.ListenerType.CFrame.
what does soundservice.listenerobject do | soundservice listenerobject property | what is the listenerobject property of a soundservice | what is listenerobject in roblox => SoundService.ListenerObject is an Instance property. The Instance whose translation or coordinate frame is used as the listener's position if ListenerType is set to Enum.ListenerType.ObjectPosition or Enum.ListenerType.ObjectCFrame.
what does soundservice.respectfilteringenabled do | soundservice respectfilteringenabled property | what is the respectfilteringenabled property of a soundservice | what is respectfilteringenabled in roblox => SoundService.RespectFilteringEnabled is a true/false property. Sets whether Sound playback from a client will replicate to the server.
what does soundservice.rolloffscale do | soundservice rolloffscale property | what is the rolloffscale property of a soundservice | what is rolloffscale in roblox => SoundService.RolloffScale is a number property. Determines how fast the volume of a Sound attenuates beyond its Sound.RollOffMinDistance.
what does soundservice:getmixertime do | how do i use getmixertime in roblox | soundservice getmixertime function => Returns a number in seconds which increases as the audio engine mixes. Use it like `game:GetService("SoundService"):GetMixerTime()`. It returns a number.
what does soundservice:playlocalsound do | how do i use playlocalsound in roblox | soundservice playlocalsound function => Plays a copy of a Sound locally, such that it will only be heard by the client calling this method. Use it like `game:GetService("SoundService"):PlayLocalSound(sound)`.

what is a sound in roblox | what does sound do in roblox | roblox sound class => Sound is a Roblox class. An object that emits sound. This object can be placed within a BasePart or Attachment to emit a sound from a particular position within a place or world, or it can be attached elsewhere to play the sound at a constant volume throughout the entire place.
what does sound.audiocontent do | sound audiocontent property | what is the audiocontent property of a sound | what is audiocontent in roblox => Sound.AudioContent is a Content property. A reference to an audio asset.
what does sound.isloaded do | sound isloaded property | what is the isloaded property of a sound => Sound.IsLoaded is a true/false property. This property is true when the Sound has loaded from Roblox servers and is ready to play. It is read-only.
what does sound.looped do | sound looped property | what is the looped property of a sound => Sound.Looped is a true/false property. Sets whether or not the Sound repeats once it has finished playing.
what does sound.loopregion do | sound loopregion property | what is the loopregion property of a sound | what is loopregion in roblox => Sound.LoopRegion is a NumberRange property. A range denoting a desired loop start and loop end within the PlaybackRegion, in seconds.
what does sound.playbackregion do | sound playbackregion property | what is the playbackregion property of a sound | what is playbackregion in roblox => Sound.PlaybackRegion is a NumberRange property. A range denoting a desired start and stop time within the TimeLength, in seconds.
what does sound.playbackregionsenabled do | sound playbackregionsenabled property | what is the playbackregionsenabled property of a sound | what is playbackregionsenabled in roblox => Sound.PlaybackRegionsEnabled is a true/false property. If true, this property gives your Sound access to the PlaybackRegion and LoopRegion properties which can more-accurately control its playback.
what does sound.playbackspeed do | sound playbackspeed property | what is the playbackspeed property of a sound | what is playbackspeed in roblox => Sound.PlaybackSpeed is a number property. Determines the speed at which a Sound will play, with higher values causing the sound to play faster and at a higher pitch.
what does sound.playonremove do | sound playonremove property | what is the playonremove property of a sound | what is playonremove in roblox => Sound.PlayOnRemove is a true/false property. When true, the Sound will play when it is removed from the experience.
what does sound.rolloffmaxdistance do | sound rolloffmaxdistance property | what is the rolloffmaxdistance property of a sound | what is rolloffmaxdistance in roblox => Sound.RollOffMaxDistance is a number property. The maximum distance, in studs, a client's listener can be from the sound's origin and still hear it. Only applies to Sounds parented to a BasePart or Attachment.
what does sound.rolloffmindistance do | sound rolloffmindistance property | what is the rolloffmindistance property of a sound | what is rolloffmindistance in roblox => Sound.RollOffMinDistance is a number property. The minimum distance, in studs, at which a Sound which is parented to a BasePart or Attachment will begin to attenuate (decrease in volume).
what does sound.rolloffmode do | sound rolloffmode property | what is the rolloffmode property of a sound | what is rolloffmode in roblox => Sound.RollOffMode is an Enum.RollOffMode property. Controls how the volume of a Sound which is parented to a BasePart or Attachment attenuates (fades out) as the distance between the listener and parent changes.
what does sound.soundgroup do | sound soundgroup property | what is the soundgroup property of a sound | what is soundgroup in roblox => Sound.SoundGroup is a SoundGroup property. The SoundGroup that is linked to this Sound.
what does sound.soundid do | sound soundid property | what is the soundid property of a sound | what is soundid in roblox => Sound.SoundId is a ContentId property. Content ID of the sound file to associate with the Sound.
what does sound.timelength do | sound timelength property | what is the timelength property of a sound | what is timelength in roblox => Sound.TimeLength is a number property. The length of the Sound in seconds. It is read-only.
what does sound.timeposition do | sound timeposition property | what is the timeposition property of a sound => Sound.TimePosition is a number property. Progress of the Sound in seconds. Can be changed to move the playback position of the Sound both before and during playback.
what does sound.volume do | sound volume property | what is the volume property of a sound => Sound.Volume is a number property. The volume of the Sound.
what does sound:pause do | sound pause function => Pauses playback of the Sound if it is playing. Use it like `sound:Pause()`.
what does sound:play do | sound play function => Plays the Sound. Use it like `sound:Play()`.
what does sound:resume do | how do i use resume in roblox | sound resume function => Resumes the Sound. Use it like `sound:Resume()`.
what does sound:stop do | how do i use stop in roblox | sound stop function => Stops the Sound. Use it like `sound:Stop()`.
what is the sound.didloop event | when does sound didloop fire | sound didloop event roblox => Fires whenever the Sound loops. Connect it with `sound.DidLoop:Connect(function(soundId, numOfTimesLooped) end)`.
what is the sound.ended event | when does sound ended fire | sound ended event roblox => Fires when the Sound has completed playback and stopped. Connect it with `sound.Ended:Connect(function(soundId) end)`.
what is the sound.loaded event | when does sound loaded fire | sound loaded event roblox => Fires when the Sound is loaded. Connect it with `sound.Loaded:Connect(function(soundId) end)`.
what is the sound.paused event | when does sound paused fire | sound paused event roblox => Fires whenever the Sound is paused using Pause(). Connect it with `sound.Paused:Connect(function(soundId) end)`.
what is the sound.played event | when does sound played fire | sound played event roblox => Fires whenever the Sound is played using Play(). Connect it with `sound.Played:Connect(function(soundId) end)`.
what is the sound.resumed event | when does sound resumed fire | sound resumed event roblox => Fires when the Sound is resumed using Resume(). Connect it with `sound.Resumed:Connect(function(soundId) end)`.
what is the sound.stopped event | when does sound stopped fire | sound stopped event roblox => Fires when the Sound is stopped through using Stop(). Connect it with `sound.Stopped:Connect(function(soundId) end)`.

Connect it with `guiObject.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) end)`.

Connect it with `game:GetService("ProximityPromptService").PromptTriggerEnded:Connect(function(prompt, playerWhoTriggered) end)`.

what is a remoteevent in roblox | what does remoteevent do in roblox | roblox remoteevent class => RemoteEvent is a Roblox class. An object which facilitates asynchronous, one-way communication across the client-server boundary. Scripts firing a RemoteEvent do not yield.
what does remoteevent:fireallclients do | how do i use fireallclients in roblox | remoteevent fireallclients function => Fires the OnClientEvent event for each connected client. Use it like `remoteEvent:FireAllClients(arguments)`.
what does remoteevent:fireclient do | how do i use fireclient in roblox | remoteevent fireclient function => Fires the OnClientEvent event for a specific client. Use it like `remoteEvent:FireClient(player, arguments)`.
what does remoteevent:fireserver do | how do i use fireserver in roblox | remoteevent fireserver function => Fires the OnServerEvent event on the server from one connected client. Use it like `remoteEvent:FireServer(arguments)`.
what is the remoteevent.onclientevent event | when does remoteevent onclientevent fire | remoteevent onclientevent event roblox => Fires from a LocalScript when either FireClient() or FireAllClients() is called on the same RemoteEvent instance from a Script. Connect it with `remoteEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(arguments) end)`.
what is the remoteevent.onserverevent event | when does remoteevent onserverevent fire | remoteevent onserverevent event roblox => Fires from a Script when FireServer() is called on the same RemoteEvent instance from a LocalScript. Connect it with `remoteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, arguments) end)`.
what is a remotefunction in roblox | what does remotefunction do in roblox | roblox remotefunction class => RemoteFunction is a Roblox class. An object which facilitates synchronous, two-way communication across the client-server boundary. Scripts invoking a RemoteFunction yield until they receive a response from the recipient.
what does remotefunction:invokeclient do | how do i use invokeclient in roblox | remotefunction invokeclient function => Invokes the RemoteFunction which in turn calls the OnClientInvoke callback. Use it like `remoteFunction:InvokeClient(player, arguments)`. It returns one or more values. It yields, so the script waits until it finishes.
what does remotefunction:invokeserver do | how do i use invokeserver in roblox | remotefunction invokeserver function => Invokes the RemoteFunction which in turn calls the OnServerInvoke callback. Use it like `remoteFunction:InvokeServer(arguments)`. It returns one or more values. It yields, so the script waits until it finishes.
what is an unreliableremoteevent in roblox | what does unreliableremoteevent do in roblox | roblox unreliableremoteevent class => UnreliableRemoteEvent is a Roblox class. An object which facilitates asynchronous, unordered and unreliable, one-way communication across the client-server boundary. Scripts firing a UnreliableRemoteEvent do not yield.
what does unreliableremoteevent:fireallclients do | unreliableremoteevent fireallclients function => Fires the OnClientEvent event for all connected clients. Has a 1000 byte limit to the payload of the event. Events with larger payloads are dropped. Use it like `unreliableRemoteEvent:FireAllClients(arguments)`.
what does unreliableremoteevent:fireclient do | unreliableremoteevent fireclient function => Fires the OnClientEvent event for a specific client. Has a 1000 byte limit to the payload of the event. Events with larger payloads are dropped. Use it like `unreliableRemoteEvent:FireClient(player, arguments)`.
what does unreliableremoteevent:fireserver do | unreliableremoteevent fireserver function => Fires the OnServerEvent event on the server from one connected client. Has a 1000 byte limit to the payload of the event. Events with larger payloads are dropped. Use it like `unreliableRemoteEvent:FireServer(arguments)`.
what is the unreliableremoteevent.onclientevent event | when does unreliableremoteevent onclientevent fire | unreliableremoteevent onclientevent event roblox => Fires from a LocalScript when either FireClient() or FireAllClients() is called on the same UnreliableRemoteEvent instance from a Script, although this firing is not guaranteed even if one of the above methods are called. Connect it with `unreliableRemoteEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(arguments) end)`.
what is the unreliableremoteevent.onserverevent event | when does unreliableremoteevent onserverevent fire | unreliableremoteevent onserverevent event roblox => Fires from a Script when FireServer() is called on the same UnreliableRemoteEvent instance from a LocalScript, although this firing is not guaranteed even if the above methods is called. Connect it with `unreliableRemoteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, arguments) end)`.
what is a bindableevent in roblox | what does bindableevent do in roblox | roblox bindableevent class => BindableEvent is a Roblox class. An object which enables custom events through asynchronous one-way communication between scripts on the same side of the client-server boundary. Scripts firing a BindableEvent do not yield.
what does bindableevent:fire do | how do i use fire in roblox | bindableevent fire function => Fires the BindableEvent which in turn fires the Event event. Use it like `bindableEvent:Fire(arguments)`.
what is the bindableevent.event event | when does bindableevent event fire | bindableevent event event roblox => Fires when any script calls the Fire() method on the same BindableEvent instance. Connect it with `bindableEvent.Event:Connect(function(arguments) end)`.
what is a bindablefunction in roblox | what does bindablefunction do in roblox | roblox bindablefunction class => BindableFunction is a Roblox class. An object which allows for synchronous two-way communication between scripts on the same side of the client-server boundary. Scripts invoking a BindableFunction yield until the corresponding callback is found.
what does bindablefunction:invoke do | how do i use invoke in roblox | bindablefunction invoke function => Invokes the BindableFunction which in turn calls the OnInvoke callback, returning any values returned by the callback. Use it like `bindableFunction:Invoke(arguments)`. It returns one or more values. It yields, so the script waits until it finishes.

what does tool:deactivate do | how do i use deactivate in roblox | tool deactivate function => Simulates deactivation of the Tool. Use it like `tool:Deactivate()`.

what does animator:applyjointvelocities do | how do i use applyjointvelocities in roblox | animator applyjointvelocities function => Computes relative velocities between parts and applies them to Motor6D.Part1. Use it like `animator:ApplyJointVelocities(motors)`.
what does animator:gettrackbyanimationid do | how do i use gettrackbyanimationid in roblox | animator gettrackbyanimationid function => Returns an existing AnimationTrack on this Animator that was loaded from an Animation with the given animation ID. what does animator:stepanimations do | how do i use stepanimations in roblox | animator stepanimations function => Increments the AnimationTrack.TimePosition of all playing AnimationTracks that are loaded onto the Animator, applying the offsets to the model associated with the Animator. For use in the command bar or by plugins only. Use it like `animator:StepAnimations(deltaTime)`.

what is an animationtrack in roblox | what does animationtrack do in roblox | roblox animationtrack class => AnimationTrack is a Roblox class. Controls the playback of an animation on an Animator.

what does animationtrack.isplaying do | animationtrack isplaying property | what is the isplaying property of a animationtrack | what is isplaying in roblox => AnimationTrack.IsPlaying is a true/false property. A read-only property that returns true when the AnimationTrack is playing. It is read-only.
what does animationtrack.length do | animationtrack length property | what is the length property of a animationtrack => AnimationTrack.Length is a number property. A read-only property that returns the length (in seconds) of an AnimationTrack. This will return 0 until the animation has fully loaded and thus may not be immediately available. It is read-only.
what does animationtrack.looped do | animationtrack looped property | what is the looped property of a animationtrack => AnimationTrack.Looped is a true/false property. Sets whether the animation will repeat after finishing. If it is changed while playing the result will take effect after the animation finishes.
what does animationtrack.priority do | animationtrack priority property | what is the priority property of a animationtrack | what is priority in roblox => AnimationTrack.Priority is an Enum.AnimationPriority property. Sets the priority of an AnimationTrack. Depending on what this is set to, playing multiple animations at once will look to this property to figure out which Keyframe Poses should be played over one another.
what does animationtrack.timeposition do | animationtrack timeposition property | what is the timeposition property of a animationtrack => AnimationTrack.TimePosition is a number property. Returns the position in time in seconds that an AnimationTrack is through playing its source animation. Can be set to make the track jump to a specific moment in the animation.
what does animationtrack:adjustspeed do | how do i use adjustspeed in roblox | animationtrack adjustspeed function => Changes the AnimationTrack.Speed of an animation. A positive value for speed plays the animation forward, a negative one plays it backwards, and 0 pauses it. Use it like `animationTrack:AdjustSpeed(speed)`.
what does animationtrack:adjustweight do | how do i use adjustweight in roblox | animationtrack adjustweight function => Changes the weight of an animation, with the optional fadeTime parameter determining how long it takes for AnimationTrack.WeightCurrent to reach AnimationTrack.WeightTarget. Use it like `animationTrack:AdjustWeight(weight, fadeTime)`.

Use it like `animationTrack:GetParameterDefaults()`. It returns a table.
what does animationtrack:gettimeofkeyframe do | how do i use gettimeofkeyframe in roblox | animationtrack gettimeofkeyframe function => Returns the time position of the first Keyframe of the given name in an AnimationTrack. Use it like `animationTrack:GetTimeOfKeyframe(keyframeName)`. It returns a number.
what does animationtrack:play do | animationtrack play function => Plays the AnimationTrack. Once called an AnimationTrack will play with the specified fadeTime, weight and speed. Use it like `animationTrack:Play(fadeTime, weight, speed)`.
what does animationtrack:setparameter do | how do i use setparameter in roblox | animationtrack setparameter function => Sets a parameter value on the animation graph, driving animation graph node inputs. Use it like `animationTrack:SetParameter(key, value)`.

what is the animationtrack.didloop event | when does animationtrack didloop fire | animationtrack didloop event roblox => Fires when an AnimationTrack loops on the next update following the end of the previous animation loop. Connect it with `animationTrack.DidLoop:Connect(function() end)`.
what is the animationtrack.ended event | when does animationtrack ended fire | animationtrack ended event roblox => Fires when the AnimationTrack is completely done moving anything in the world. Connect it with `animationTrack.Ended:Connect(function() end)`.
what is the animationtrack.stopped event | when does animationtrack stopped fire | animationtrack stopped event roblox => Fires when the AnimationTrack finishes playing. The AnimationTrack might still animate the subject while the animation "fades out". To catch when the AnimationTrack is completely done moving anything in the world, use the AnimationTrack.Ended event. Connect it with `animationTrack.Stopped:Connect(function() end)`.

what is a ropeconstraint in roblox | what does ropeconstraint do in roblox | roblox ropeconstraint class => RopeConstraint is a Roblox class. Simulates rope dynamics, preventing two attachments from separating further than a defined length.

what does springconstraint.damping do | springconstraint damping property | what is the damping property of a springconstraint | what is damping in roblox => SpringConstraint.Damping is a number property. Damping constant for the SpringConstraint. Multiplied to the velocity of the constraint's Attachments to reduce the spring force applied.
what does springconstraint.freelength do | springconstraint freelength property | what is the freelength property of a springconstraint | what is freelength in roblox => SpringConstraint.FreeLength is a number property. Natural resting length of the spring.
what does springconstraint.limitsenabled do | springconstraint limitsenabled property | what is the limitsenabled property of a springconstraint => SpringConstraint.LimitsEnabled is a true/false property. Sets whether the SpringConstraint enforces a minimum and maximum length.

what does springconstraint.minlength do | springconstraint minlength property | what is the minlength property of a springconstraint => SpringConstraint.MinLength is a number property. The minimum separation the SpringConstraint will allow if LimitsEnabled is true.
what does springconstraint.radius do | springconstraint radius property | what is the radius property of a springconstraint => SpringConstraint.Radius is a number property. The visualized radius of the spring's coils.
what does springconstraint.stiffness do | springconstraint stiffness property | what is the stiffness property of a springconstraint | what is stiffness in roblox => SpringConstraint.Stiffness is a number property. The strength of the spring. The higher this value the more force will be applied when the attachments are separated a different length than the FreeLength.
what does springconstraint.thickness do | springconstraint thickness property | what is the thickness property of a springconstraint => SpringConstraint.Thickness is a number property. The visualized thickness of the spring's coils.
what is a rodconstraint in roblox | what does rodconstraint do in roblox | roblox rodconstraint class => RodConstraint is a Roblox class. Keeps two attachments separated by its defined Length.
what does rodconstraint.length do | rodconstraint length property | what is the length property of a rodconstraint => RodConstraint.Length is a number property. The distance apart at which the constraint attempts to keep its Attachments.
what does rodconstraint.limitangle0 do | rodconstraint limitangle0 property | what is the limitangle0 property of a rodconstraint | what is limitangle0 in roblox => RodConstraint.LimitAngle0 is a number property. The maximum angle between the rod and Attachment0 when LimitsEnabled is true.
what does rodconstraint.limitangle1 do | rodconstraint limitangle1 property | what is the limitangle1 property of a rodconstraint | what is limitangle1 in roblox => RodConstraint.LimitAngle1 is a number property. The maximum angle between the rod and Attachment1 when LimitsEnabled is true.
what does rodconstraint.limitsenabled do | rodconstraint limitsenabled property | what is the limitsenabled property of a rodconstraint => RodConstraint.LimitsEnabled is a true/false property. Determines whether LimitAngle0 and LimitAngle1 control the angles between the rod and the respective attachments.
what does rodconstraint.thickness do | rodconstraint thickness property | what is the thickness property of a rodconstraint => RodConstraint.Thickness is a number property. The visualized thickness of the RodConstraint.
what is a prismaticconstraint in roblox | what does prismaticconstraint do in roblox | roblox prismaticconstraint class => PrismaticConstraint is a Roblox class. Constraint which creates a rigid joint between two Attachments, allowing them to slide along one axis but not rotate.
what is a ballsocketconstraint in roblox | what does ballsocketconstraint do in roblox | roblox ballsocketconstraint class => BallSocketConstraint is a Roblox class. Forces its two attachments into the same position and allows them to freely rotate about all three axes, with optional limits to restrict both tilt and twist.
what does ballsocketconstraint.limitsenabled do | ballsocketconstraint limitsenabled property | what is the limitsenabled property of a ballsocketconstraint => BallSocketConstraint.LimitsEnabled is a true/false property. Sets whether the BallSocketConstraint sets a limit on rotation based on UpperAngle.

Sets the maximum frictional torque applied to keep its Attachments aligned.
what does ballsocketconstraint.radius do | ballsocketconstraint radius property | what is the radius property of a ballsocketconstraint => BallSocketConstraint.Radius is a number property. The visualized radius of the BallSocketConstraint.
what does ballsocketconstraint.restitution do | ballsocketconstraint restitution property | what is the restitution property of a ballsocketconstraint => BallSocketConstraint.Restitution is a number property. How elastic Attachments connected by a BallSocketConstraint will be when they reach the end of the range specified by UpperAngle when LimitsEnabled is true.
what does ballsocketconstraint.twistlimitsenabled do | ballsocketconstraint twistlimitsenabled property | what is the twistlimitsenabled property of a ballsocketconstraint | what is twistlimitsenabled in roblox => BallSocketConstraint.TwistLimitsEnabled is a true/false property. Sets whether the BallSocketConstraint sets a limit on twist rotation based on TwistUpperAngle and TwistLowerAngle.
what does ballsocketconstraint.twistlowerangle do | ballsocketconstraint twistlowerangle property | what is the twistlowerangle property of a ballsocketconstraint | what is twistlowerangle in roblox => BallSocketConstraint.TwistLowerAngle is a number property. Sets the lower twist rotation limit of the BallSocketConstraint, as long as TwistLimitsEnabled is true.
what does ballsocketconstraint.twistupperangle do | ballsocketconstraint twistupperangle property | what is the twistupperangle property of a ballsocketconstraint | what is twistupperangle in roblox => BallSocketConstraint.TwistUpperAngle is a number property. Sets the upper twist rotation limit of the BallSocketConstraint, as long as TwistLimitsEnabled is true.
what does ballsocketconstraint.upperangle do | ballsocketconstraint upperangle property | what is the upperangle property of a ballsocketconstraint => BallSocketConstraint.UpperAngle is a number property. Sets the upper rotation limit of the BallSocketConstraint, as long as LimitsEnabled is true.
what is an alignposition in roblox | what does alignposition do in roblox | roblox alignposition class => AlignPosition is a Roblox class. Constraint which applies force to move two attachments together, or to move one attachment to a goal position.

Whether force is applied to the parent of Attachment0 at that attachment's location, or at the parents' center of mass.
what does alignposition.forcelimitmode do | alignposition forcelimitmode property | what is the forcelimitmode property of a alignposition => AlignPosition.ForceLimitMode is an Enum.ForceLimitMode property. Determines how the constraint force will be limited. Only used if RigidityEnabled is false.
what does alignposition.forcerelativeto do | alignposition forcerelativeto property | what is the forcerelativeto property of a alignposition | what is forcerelativeto in roblox => AlignPosition.ForceRelativeTo is an Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo property. Determines the axes that the constraint uses to limit the force. Only applies when RigidityEnabled is false and AlignPosition.ForceLimitMode is PerAxis. .
what does alignposition.maxaxesforce do | alignposition maxaxesforce property | what is the maxaxesforce property of a alignposition => AlignPosition.MaxAxesForce is a Vector3 property. Maximum force along each axis that the constraint can apply to achieve its goal.

what does alignposition.position do | alignposition position property | what is the position property of a alignposition => AlignPosition.Position is a Vector3 property. The position to which the constraint should move its Attachment0.
what does alignposition.reactionforceenabled do | alignposition reactionforceenabled property | what is the reactionforceenabled property of a alignposition => AlignPosition.ReactionForceEnabled is a true/false property. Whether the constraint applies force only to Attachment0, or to both attachments in equal and opposite directions.
what does alignposition.responsiveness do | alignposition responsiveness property | what is the responsiveness property of a alignposition => AlignPosition.Responsiveness is a number property. Controls how quickly the constraint reaches its goal. Higher values cause the attachment(s) to align more rapidly.
what does alignposition.rigidityenabled do | alignposition rigidityenabled property | what is the rigidityenabled property of a alignposition => AlignPosition.RigidityEnabled is a true/false property. Whether force is dependent on other properties, or if the physics solver reacts as quickly as possible to complete the alignment.

what does particleemitter.rate do | particleemitter rate property | what is the rate property of a particleemitter => ParticleEmitter.Rate is a number property. Determines the number of particles emitted per second.
what does particleemitter.rotation do | particleemitter rotation property | what is the rotation property of a particleemitter => ParticleEmitter.Rotation is a NumberRange property. Determines the range of rotations in degrees for newly emitted particles.
what does particleemitter.rotspeed do | particleemitter rotspeed property | what is the rotspeed property of a particleemitter | what is rotspeed in roblox => ParticleEmitter.RotSpeed is a NumberRange property. Determines the range of angular speeds of emitted particles, measured in degrees per second.
what does particleemitter.shape do | particleemitter shape property | what is the shape property of a particleemitter => ParticleEmitter.Shape is an Enum.ParticleEmitterShape property. Sets the shape of the emitter to either a box, sphere, cylinder, or disc.
what does particleemitter.shapeinout do | particleemitter shapeinout property | what is the shapeinout property of a particleemitter | what is shapeinout in roblox => ParticleEmitter.ShapeInOut is an Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut property. Sets whether particles emit outward only, inward only, or in both directions.
what does particleemitter.shapepartial do | particleemitter shapepartial property | what is the shapepartial property of a particleemitter | what is shapepartial in roblox => ParticleEmitter.ShapePartial is a number property. Influences particle emission from cylinder, disc, sphere, and box shapes.
what does particleemitter.shapestyle do | particleemitter shapestyle property | what is the shapestyle property of a particleemitter | what is shapestyle in roblox => ParticleEmitter.ShapeStyle is an Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle property. Sets particle emission to either volumetric or surface-only emission.
what does particleemitter.size do | particleemitter size property | what is the size property of a particleemitter => ParticleEmitter.Size is a NumberSequence property. Determines the world size over individual particles' lifetimes.
what does particleemitter.speed do | particleemitter speed property | what is the speed property of a particleemitter => ParticleEmitter.Speed is a NumberRange property. Determines a random range of velocities (minimum to maximum) at which new particles will emit, measured in studs per second.
what does particleemitter.spreadangle do | particleemitter spreadangle property | what is the spreadangle property of a particleemitter | what is spreadangle in roblox => ParticleEmitter.SpreadAngle is a Vector2 property. Determines the angles at which particles may be randomly emit, measured in degrees.
what does particleemitter.squash do | particleemitter squash property | what is the squash property of a particleemitter | what is squash in roblox => ParticleEmitter.Squash is a NumberSequence property. Allows for non-uniform scaling of particles, curve-controlled over their lifetime.
what does particleemitter.texture do | particleemitter texture property | what is the texture property of a particleemitter => ParticleEmitter.Texture is a ContentId property. Determines the image rendered on particles.
what does particleemitter.texturecontent do | particleemitter texturecontent property | what is the texturecontent property of a particleemitter => ParticleEmitter.TextureContent is a Content property. The image rendered on particles. Supports asset URIs.
what does particleemitter.timescale do | particleemitter timescale property | what is the timescale property of a particleemitter => ParticleEmitter.TimeScale is a number property. Value between 0 and 1 that controls the speed of the particle effect.
what does particleemitter.transparency do | particleemitter transparency property | what is the transparency property of a particleemitter => ParticleEmitter.Transparency is a NumberSequence property. Determines the transparency of particles over their individual lifetimes.
what does particleemitter.velocityinheritance do | particleemitter velocityinheritance property | what is the velocityinheritance property of a particleemitter | what is velocityinheritance in roblox => ParticleEmitter.VelocityInheritance is a number property. Determines how much of the parent's velocity is inherited by particles when emitted.
what does particleemitter.windaffectsdrag do | particleemitter windaffectsdrag property | what is the windaffectsdrag property of a particleemitter | what is windaffectsdrag in roblox => ParticleEmitter.WindAffectsDrag is a true/false property. Whether emitted particles follow the Workspace.GlobalWind vector.
what does particleemitter.zoffset do | particleemitter zoffset property | what is the zoffset property of a particleemitter => ParticleEmitter.ZOffset is a number property. Determines the forward-backward render position of particles; used to control what particles render on top/bottom.
what does particleemitter:clear do | particleemitter clear function => Clears all particles that have been emitted. Use it like `particleEmitter:Clear()`.
what does particleemitter:emit do | how do i use emit in roblox | particleemitter emit function => Emits a given number of particles. Use it like `particleEmitter:Emit(particleCount)`.
what is a pointlight in roblox | what does pointlight do in roblox | roblox pointlight class => PointLight is a Roblox class. A light source that emits illumination from a single point.
what does pointlight.range do | pointlight range property | what is the range property of a pointlight => PointLight.Range is a number property. The size of the area that the PointLight will illuminate.
what is a spotlight in roblox | what does spotlight do in roblox | roblox spotlight class => SpotLight is a Roblox class. A light source that emits light directionally in the shape of a cone with a spherical base.
what does spotlight.angle do | spotlight angle property | what is the angle property of a spotlight => SpotLight.Angle is a number property. The angle of which the light is shone from the SpotLight.
what does spotlight.face do | spotlight face property | what is the face property of a spotlight => SpotLight.Face is an Enum.NormalId property. Sets the side of the parent that the SpotLight comes from.
what does spotlight.range do | spotlight range property | what is the range property of a spotlight => SpotLight.Range is a number property. The size of the area that the SpotLight will illuminate.
what is a surfacelight in roblox | what does surfacelight do in roblox | roblox surfacelight class => SurfaceLight is a Roblox class. A light source that emits illumination of a specified color and brightness from a face for a specified range.
what does surfacelight.angle do | surfacelight angle property | what is the angle property of a surfacelight => SurfaceLight.Angle is a number property. The angle of which the light is shone from the SurfaceLight.
what does surfacelight.face do | surfacelight face property | what is the face property of a surfacelight => SurfaceLight.Face is an Enum.NormalId property. Sets the side of the parent that the SurfaceLight comes from.
what does surfacelight.range do | surfacelight range property | what is the range property of a surfacelight => SurfaceLight.Range is a number property. The distance from the SurfaceLight's face that will illuminate.
what does light.color do | light color property | what is the color property of a light => Light.Color is a Color3 property. The color of the emitted light.
what does light.enabled do | light enabled property | what is the enabled property of a light => Light.Enabled is a true/false property. If set to true, light will be emitted from the source object.
what does light.shadows do | light shadows property | what is the shadows property of a light => Light.Shadows is a true/false property. If set to true, will project shadows if light is blocked by an obstacle.
what is a fire in roblox | what does fire do in roblox | roblox fire class => Fire is a Roblox class. A preconfigured particle emitter with the visual aesthetic of fire.

what does fire.heat do | fire heat property | what is the heat property of a fire => Fire.Heat is a number property. Determines the velocity at which particles are emit.
what does fire.secondarycolor do | fire secondarycolor property | what is the secondarycolor property of a fire | what is secondarycolor in roblox => Fire.SecondaryColor is a Color3 property. Determines the color of the of the secondary (inner) flame particles.
what does fire.size do | fire size property | what is the size property of a fire => Fire.Size is a number property. Determines the size of the flame particles.
what does fire.timescale do | fire timescale property | what is the timescale property of a fire => Fire.TimeScale is a number property. Controls the speed of the particle effect.

what is an explosion in roblox | what does explosion do in roblox | roblox explosion class => Explosion is a Roblox class. Applies force to BaseParts within the explosion's Explosion.BlastRadius. Breaks JointInstances and WeldConstraints between parts and kills Humanoid characters not protected by a ForceField.
what does explosion.blastpressure do | explosion blastpressure property | what is the blastpressure property of a explosion | what is blastpressure in roblox => Explosion.BlastPressure is a number property. Used to determine the amount of force applied to BaseParts caught in the Explosion.BlastRadius.
what does explosion.blastradius do | explosion blastradius property | what is the blastradius property of a explosion | what is blastradius in roblox => Explosion.BlastRadius is a number property. This property determines the radius of the Explosion, in studs. This radius determines the area of effect of the explosion, not the size of the explosion's visuals.
what does explosion.destroyjointradiuspercent do | explosion destroyjointradiuspercent property | what is the destroyjointradiuspercent property of a explosion | what is destroyjointradiuspercent in roblox => Explosion.DestroyJointRadiusPercent is a number property. Used to set the proportion of the Explosion.BlastRadius, between 0 and 1, within which all joints will be destroyed. Anything outside of this range will only have the Explosion force applied to it.
what does explosion.explosiontype do | explosion explosiontype property | what is the explosiontype property of a explosion | what is explosiontype in roblox => Explosion.ExplosionType is an Enum.ExplosionType property. This property determines how the Explosion will interact with Terrain. Used to set if explosions will cause damage to the terrain or not.
what does explosion.position do | explosion position property | what is the position property of a explosion => Explosion.Position is a Vector3 property. This property is the position of the center of the Explosion. It is defined in world-space and not influenced by the Explosion parent.
what does explosion.timescale do | explosion timescale property | what is the timescale property of a explosion => Explosion.TimeScale is a number property. Value between 0 and 1 that controls the speed of the particle effect.
what does explosion.visible do | explosion visible property | what is the visible property of a explosion => Explosion.Visible is a true/false property. This property determines whether or not the visual effect of an Explosion is shown or not.
what is the explosion.hit event | when does explosion hit fire | explosion hit event roblox => Fires when the Explosion hits a BasePart within its Explosion.BlastRadius. Returns the part hit along with the distance of the part from Explosion.Position. Connect it with `explosion.Hit:Connect(function(part, distance) end)`.
what is a spawnlocation in roblox | what does spawnlocation do in roblox | roblox spawnlocation class => SpawnLocation is a Roblox class. SpawnLocations, or "spawns" determine where a Player respawns when they die. They can be configured to allow only certain players to use each spawn, using Teams. They also control how ForceFields are set up for newly-spawned players.
what does spawnlocation.allowteamchangeontouch do | spawnlocation allowteamchangeontouch property | what is the allowteamchangeontouch property of a spawnlocation | what is allowteamchangeontouch in roblox => SpawnLocation.AllowTeamChangeOnTouch is a true/false property. Allows a Player to join the team by touching the SpawnLocation. When set to true, if a Player character comes into contact with the SpawnLocation, the player's Player.TeamColor will be set to SpawnLocation.TeamColor.
what does spawnlocation.duration do | spawnlocation duration property | what is the duration property of a spawnlocation | what is duration in roblox => SpawnLocation.Duration is a whole number property. The length of time, in seconds, that a ForceField will be applied to a Player character spawning at this SpawnLocation. If Duration is zero, the ForceField is never created, and it will not trigger the Instance.DescendantAdded or Instance.ChildAdded events.
what does spawnlocation.enabled do | spawnlocation enabled property | what is the enabled property of a spawnlocation => SpawnLocation.Enabled is a true/false property. Sets whether or not the SpawnLocation is enabled. When disabled players cannot spawn at the SpawnLocation and the AllowTeamChangeOnTouch functionality is disabled.
what does spawnlocation.neutral do | spawnlocation neutral property | what is the neutral property of a spawnlocation => SpawnLocation.Neutral is a true/false property. Whether or not a SpawnLocation is affiliated with a specific team. This means that any Player, of any Team, can spawn on it if this property is set to true.
what does spawnlocation.teamcolor do | spawnlocation teamcolor property | what is the teamcolor property of a spawnlocation => SpawnLocation.TeamColor is a BrickColor property. Sets what team the SpawnLocation is affiliated to. If SpawnLocation.Neutral property is false, only Players with the same Player.TeamColor as the spawn's TeamColor will be able to spawn there.
what is a team in roblox | what does team do in roblox | roblox team class => Team is a Roblox class. The Team class represents a faction in a Roblox place. The only valid parent for a Team is in the Teams service.
what does team.autoassignable do | team autoassignable property | what is the autoassignable property of a team | what is autoassignable in roblox => Team.AutoAssignable is a true/false property. This property determines whether Players will be automatically placed onto the Team when joining. If multiple teams have this property set to true, Roblox will attempt to even the teams out when Players are added.
what does team.teamcolor do | team teamcolor property | what is the teamcolor property of a team => Team.TeamColor is a BrickColor property. This property sets the color of the Team. Determines the Player.TeamColor property of players who are a member of the team. Also determines the color displayed on the player list and above player's heads.
what does team:getplayers do | team getplayers function => Returns a list of Players who are assigned to the Team. A Player is considered assigned if their Player.Team property is equal to the Team and Player.Neutral is false. Use it like `team:GetPlayers()`. It returns an array (a list table).
what is the team.playeradded event | when does team playeradded fire | team playeradded event roblox => Fires whenever a Player is assigned to the Team. A player is considered assigned if their Player.Team property is equal to the Team and Player.Neutral is false. Connect it with `team.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) end)`.
what is the team.playerremoved event | when does team playerremoved fire | team playerremoved event roblox => Fires whenever a Player is removed from a Team. This can be due to the Player leaving the game, Player.Neutral being set to true or the Player joining a different team. Connect it with `team.PlayerRemoved:Connect(function(player) end)`.
what does teams:getteams do | how do i use getteams in roblox | teams getteams function => Returns a table containing the game's Team objects. Will only return Team objects that are parented to the Teams service. Use it like `game:GetService("Teams"):GetTeams()`. It returns an array (a list table).

Determines whether TextChatService should create default TextChannels.
what does textchatservice:canuserchatasync do | how do i use canuserchatasync in roblox | textchatservice canuserchatasync function => Determines whether a user has permission to chat in experiences. Use it like `game:GetService("TextChatService"):CanUserChatAsync(userId)`. It returns true or false. It yields, so the script waits until it finishes.
what does textchatservice:canuserschatasync do | how do i use canuserschatasync in roblox | textchatservice canuserschatasync function => Determines whether or not two users can receive messages from each other. Use it like `game:GetService("TextChatService"):CanUsersChatAsync(userIdFrom, userIdTo)`. It returns true or false. It yields, so the script waits until it finishes.
what does textchatservice:canusersdirectchatasync do | how do i use canusersdirectchatasync in roblox | textchatservice canusersdirectchatasync function => Determines whether a user has permission to chat directly with other users in experiences based on factors such as their parental control settings. Use it like `game:GetService("TextChatService"):CanUsersDirectChatAsync(requesterUserId, userIds)`. It returns an array (a list table). It yields, so the script waits until it finishes.
what does textchatservice:displaybubble do | how do i use displaybubble in roblox | textchatservice displaybubble function => Displays a chat bubble above the provided part or player character. Use it like `game:GetService("TextChatService"):DisplayBubble(partOrCharacter, message)`.
what does textchatservice:getchatgroupsasync do | how do i use getchatgroupsasync in roblox | textchatservice getchatgroupsasync function => Returns chat group IDs that indicate which players can synchronously text chat together. Use it like `game:GetService("TextChatService"):GetChatGroupsAsync(players)`. It returns an array (a list table). It yields, so the script waits until it finishes.
what is the textchatservice.bubbledisplayed event | when does textchatservice bubbledisplayed fire | textchatservice bubbledisplayed event roblox => Fires when TextChatService:DisplayBubble() is called. Connect it with `game:GetService("TextChatService").BubbleDisplayed:Connect(function(partOrCharacter, textChatMessage) end)`.
what is the textchatservice.messagereceived event | when does textchatservice messagereceived fire | textchatservice messagereceived event roblox => Fires when TextChannel:DisplaySystemMessage() is invoked on the client, or when the client receives a valid TextChannel:SendAsync() response from the server. Connect it with `game:GetService("TextChatService").MessageReceived:Connect(function(textChatMessage) end)`.
what is the textchatservice.sendingmessage event | when does textchatservice sendingmessage fire | textchatservice sendingmessage event roblox => Fires when TextChannel:SendAsync() is called by the sending client. Connect it with `game:GetService("TextChatService").SendingMessage:Connect(function(textChatMessage) end)`.

what is a cframe in roblox | what is the cframe data type | roblox cframe datatype => CFrame is a Roblox data type. A data type that represents both a 3D position and orientation.
what is cframe.identity | cframe identity in roblox | what does cframe.identity mean | what is identity in roblox => CFrame.identity: An identity CFrame with no translation or rotation.
what is cframe.position | cframe position in roblox | what does cframe.position mean => CFrame.Position: The 3D position of the CFrame.
what is cframe.rotation | cframe rotation in roblox | what does cframe.rotation mean => CFrame.Rotation: A copy of the CFrame with no translation.
what is cframe.x | cframe x in roblox | what does cframe.x mean => CFrame.X: The X coordinate of the position.
what is cframe.y | cframe y in roblox | what does cframe.y mean => CFrame.Y: The Y coordinate of the position.
what is cframe.z | cframe z in roblox | what does cframe.z mean => CFrame.Z: The Z coordinate of the position.
what is cframe.lookvector | cframe lookvector in roblox | what does cframe.lookvector mean | what is lookvector in roblox => CFrame.LookVector: The forward-direction component of the CFrame object's orientation, equivalent to the negated form of ZVector.
what is cframe.rightvector | cframe rightvector in roblox | what does cframe.rightvector mean | what is rightvector in roblox => CFrame.RightVector: The right-direction component of the CFrame object's orientation.
what is cframe.upvector | cframe upvector in roblox | what does cframe.upvector mean | what is upvector in roblox => CFrame.UpVector: The up-direction component of the CFrame object's orientation.
what is cframe.xvector | cframe xvector in roblox | what does cframe.xvector mean | what is xvector in roblox => CFrame.XVector: Equivalent to RightVector.
what is cframe.yvector | cframe yvector in roblox | what does cframe.yvector mean | what is yvector in roblox => CFrame.YVector: Equivalent to UpVector.
what is cframe.zvector | cframe zvector in roblox | what does cframe.zvector mean | what is zvector in roblox => CFrame.ZVector: The Z component of the CFrame object's orientation. Equivalent to the third column of the rotation matrix.

what does string.byte do in roblox | how do i use string.byte | string byte in luau => Returns the internal numerical codes of the characters s[i], s[i+1], ..., s[j]. The default value for i is 1; the default value for j is i. These indices are corrected following the same rules of function string.sub. Use it like `string.byte(s, i, j)`. It returns a number.
